output.summary: KEP-970 proposes redesigning the kubeadm config file format: decoupling kubeadm ComponentConfig types from other components, separating cluster-wide, control-plane instance, node/kubelet, and runtime settings, and using specialized substructures instead of a flat object. Its current status is implementable at alpha stage, from 2020-12-29.
output.rationale:
The kubeadm config file has grown into the only way to set many options (external etcd, control plane and kube-proxy/kubelet parameters), and it also serves as a persisted cluster spec used by later commands like kubeadm upgrade. The KEP aims to give it a more stable, reliable format as a prerequisite for graduating kubeadm to GA. The source notes the change is costly: differences from the current format may confuse users, and the codebase impact needs a high commitment from the SIG.</rationale>
<parameter name="outcome_reason">null

evidence.quote: providing a more stable and reliable config file format is considered one of the top priorities for graduating kubeadm itself to GA
with the aim to provide a better support for high availability clusters, it should be provided a clear separation between cluster wide settings
The differences from the current kubeadm config are relevant and kubeadm users can get confused.
The impacts on the current codebase are considerable it is required an high commitment from the SIG.
